# Wayland activation source

The activation manager is adapted from **KWindowSystem 6.32.0**, commit
`870fed584663656db8b5e3d4ec1a7048b5eff25f`, by **Aleix Pol Gonzalez (2021)**,
under **LGPL-2.0-or-later**. The original notices remain in both files and the
complete license is in `LICENSES/LGPL-2.0-or-later.txt`.

| Original source | Git blob |
| --- | --- |
| [waylandxdgactivationv1.cpp](https://github.com/KDE/kwindowsystem/blob/870fed584663656db8b5e3d4ec1a7048b5eff25f/src/platforms/wayland/waylandxdgactivationv1.cpp) | `5ae4d285e38762b90b603c0bc5047bbbf70f5c8b` |
| [waylandxdgactivationv1_p.h](https://github.com/KDE/kwindowsystem/blob/870fed584663656db8b5e3d4ec1a7048b5eff25f/src/platforms/wayland/waylandxdgactivationv1_p.h) | `629d45efaf6cfd5bff507e53f4ca1816547e92d4` |

The process-wide singleton and token-generation/provider classes are omitted.
This manager is owned by the shared window-activation service and only sends an
existing launcher/Portal token to its actual Qt-owned `wl_surface`. Global
removal also releases the protocol proxy, as with the existing foreign exporter.
It is destroyed before QApplication releases the QPA connection. No global token
environment, generated serial, separate display, roundtrip or private Qt shell
implementation is used.

The reviewed KDE [windowsystem.cpp](https://github.com/KDE/kwindowsystem/blob/870fed584663656db8b5e3d4ec1a7048b5eff25f/src/platforms/wayland/windowsystem.cpp),
blob `b9b69562d73b11748eec0747da565199953932c5`, establishes the actual
`activate(token, surface)` flow. That file is an inspection reference, not copied
into this project.

The binding is generated by fixed Qt 6.12.1 from the verbatim
[xdg-activation-v1.xml](../wayland-protocols/xdg-activation-v1.xml), qtbase commit
`5af1a37e31a869cd6eb8a73d82e2c71a450e6634`, original path
`src/3rdparty/wayland/protocols/xdg-activation/xdg-activation-v1.xml`, blob
`d87e633745b870ab479701048416edd14692afde`. Its embedded MIT notice credits
Aleix Pol Gonzalez and Carlos Garnacho (2020). It explicitly permits the
compositor to ignore an activation request; successful dispatch is not proof
that a window received focus.

Qt's public `QWaylandApplication` exposes input seats and serials but no
per-window token setter. The adapter uses only the same version-matched native
surface interface already required by PortalParent:
`src/gui/kernel/qplatformwindow_p.h`, blob
`73b995a84c5607ca0016f1658e75e36e49b24294`. Qt APIs are linked, not copied.
